assertions.check: Each competitor has pricing data with specific numbers, not ranges
Each competitor has at least 3 cited weaknesses from real user reviews
Matrix includes a clear 'our advantage' column with differentiation
All data points have source URLs or citations from the last 12 months
Contains at least 1 indirect competitor or substitute category
Feature comparison uses binary (has/doesn't have) not subjective ratings
Includes market share or funding data where publicly available

meta_assertion: Would a first-time reader understand the competitive landscape well enough to make a go/no-go decision?
test_prompt: Build a competitor matrix for a SaaS product that helps solo developers automate their deployment pipelines.
